Undergraduate Admissions
Undergraduate admission deadlines follow the official university schedule. Please refer to the University Admissions Deadlines published by the central admissions office for the most current information (https://ualr.edu/admissions/calendar/).
Graduate Admissions
Graduate program applications are accepted on a rolling basis. However, for full consideration, applicants are strongly encouraged to submit all required materials by the priority deadlines below:
– Fall Admission: March 31
– Spring Admission: September 30
Please note that summer admission is not offered.
